run: PHASE D RE-RUN - paired v15-vs-v16 over the same 400 (+ Run 2 part 3, part-3 rows judged)

provenance.method_note: Fetched from HF and VERIFIED by sha256, then EVERY number below was RECOMPUTED from the raw v15_results / v16_results / part3_results rows, independently of the summary block. All recomputations matched.

determinism.part3_byte_identical_to_3ac522a: 78/90 and 74/90, same win lists, same 20 identical answers

headline.CALL_1_adr_bar: PASSES on both limbs: raw +0.5 pts (302/384 vs 300/384), reliable +1.1 pts (219/268 vs 212/263). First time ADR 0001 section 10 has ever been satisfied.
headline.fact_path: unchanged and clean: +2.2 raw / +2.3 reliable at n=193.
headline.flips: 19 gains / 17 regressions (was 11 / 37). 21 regressions fixed, 0 gains lost, 1 new.

classification_scheme.A: extraction coverage failure - the input IS present and v16 did not use it
classification_scheme.B: never-guess CORRECT - the gold is itself a clarification, or the input is genuinely unusable
classification_scheme.C: v16 answer substantively CORRECT (judge-confirmed), scorer false-fail on output SHAPE

classification_scheme.E: rate x quantity / composition - known deferrals (patterns D, E, F)

adjudication_of_the_17_regressions.method: The frontier judge was applied to V15 answers, because a regression is only real if v15 was right. On 9 of the 17 it was not.

verdict_on_the_17: SIX are real quality regressions: 2 retrieval (Class D, removable by dropping the two-arm retriever) and 4 extraction (Class A, of which ONE - eval_368 - is new and was caused by pattern B). NINE are v15 FALSE-PASSES: the regex scorer credits v15 for wrong answers that echo the questions own digits (eval_293 answers PAYE = TZS 0 on a 600,000 salary; eval_329 answers TZS 1,925,000 where gold is 0 and 105,000). TWO are v16 FALSE-FAILS where the judge confirms v16 correct. There is no class in which v16 answers WORSE than v15 while both are answering.
no_class_of_regression_clause: SATISFIED CONDITIONAL on (a) removing Class D by dropping the two-arm retriever and (b) fixing eval_368. Not resolved before those two.
compute_raw_minus_2_explained: Exactly 13 gains minus 15 regressions in that bucket. 13 of the 15 are v16 clarifications, and the judge calls v15 WRONG on 9 of them. The -2.0 is the regex scorer paying v15 for wrong answers that intersect the questions digits. The same bucket on the reliable denominator is +4.0.

CALL_3_judge_comparison_like_for_like.asymmetry_is_smaller_than_the_graded_cou: v15 graded 379, v16 352 - but 18 of v16s 32 clarifications sit INSIDE the reliable set and are already scored FAIL. Only 14 are excluded outright (v15: 1). The real exclusion gap is 14 rows, not 27.
CALL_3_judge_comparison_like_for_like.reported_figure: v15 267/359 = 74.4% vs v16 291/363 = 80.2% -> +5.8 pts. Near the TOP of the range; do not quote it alone.
CALL_3_judge_comparison_like_for_like.HONEST_RANGE: +3.0 to +6.2 pts, strictest like-for-like +3.5. The load-bearing point is that NO accounting flips the sign - including the one that counts all 32 clarifications as failures.
CALL_3_judge_comparison_like_for_like.symmetric_honesty_on_the_gains: 5 of the 19 gains are judge-FALSE: eval_008, eval_034, eval_186, eval_321, eval_331. Four of those five are fact-path rows credited by the two-arm retriever.

CALL_2_two_arm_retriever.instrument_2_judge_augmented_common_deno: two-arm 67/85 = 78.8% vs single-arm 67/85 = 78.8% -> 0.0 pts (6 wins each side)
CALL_2_two_arm_retriever.instrument_3_pure_judge_both_arms_graded: two-arm 53/81 = 65.4% vs single-arm 60/81 = 74.1% -> -8.6 pts (4 wins vs 11)
CALL_2_two_arm_retriever.harness_reported_minus_0_2: comes from unequal denominators (89 vs 85); the common-denominator figure is a dead heat.
CALL_2_two_arm_retriever.THE_SCORER_POINTED_THE_WRONG_WAY_TWICE_O: Part 3 reproduced EXACTLY from 3ac522a. +4.4 was not a sampling fluke - it is a systematic property of number-set-intersection scoring applied to a retriever whose entire job is to inject MORE numbers into the prompt. On eval_331 the two instruments disagree on DIRECTION outright.
CALL_2_two_arm_retriever.DECISIVE: Both Class D regressions (eval_127, eval_208) are answered CORRECTLY by the single-arm retriever. Dropping the two-arm retriever deletes the entire class.
CALL_2_two_arm_retriever.CALL: DO NOT SHIP the two-arm retriever. Approved by the founder 2026-08-08.
CALL_2_two_arm_retriever.the_cost_stated_plainly: Under the regex scorer, single-arm costs 6 rows and gains 2 -> ALL_400 raw about 298 vs v15 300 = -0.5 pts, and the ADR raw bar would FAIL as literally measured. But 4 of those 6 lost rows are judge-WRONG. This is why the bar must be re-measured on the shipped configuration rather than argued about.
CALL_2_two_arm_retriever.unmeasured_surface: 100 compute-routed, second-arm-eligible questions were OUTSIDE the part-3 subset (which excludes compute-routed rows). The -0.5 estimate is on the measured 90 only.

CALL_4_new_vs_carried.new_gains_note: All 8 are PREREQ-2 Tier 1-2, and all 8 are judge-confirmed correct.
CALL_4_new_vs_carried.eval_368_root_cause: _GROUP_MARKERS contains "wa muda" / "wa kudumu", added in pattern B to catch a genuine two-group split. It also fires on a SINGLE group described as part-time, so has_multiple_groups returns True, parse_count returns None, and the applicability route asks for a headcount that is in the question. This is the nat_07 class: flagged, not silently fixed.
CALL_4_new_vs_carried.eval_368_blast_radius: Exactly 3 corpus rows, all currently wrong: eval_368, eval_377, and eval_225 (which matches "muda wa siku 30", a time period with no employment sense at all). Two rows MUST keep firing: edge_p04 and ex_10, both of which name BOTH sides of a real split.

residual_clarifications_weighed.count: 32 in-scope, 27 of them compute-routed = 26% of the 103 compute questions
residual_clarifications_weighed.the_case_FOR_them: Across all 32, the frontier judge says v15 answered WRONG on 20, correct on 4, undetermined on 3, and 5 were ungraded. Twenty times a clarification replaced a confident wrong number.
residual_clarifications_weighed.the_case_AGAINST_them: A quarter of the time a trader asks for a number, CHIKE asks a question back. Four are unnecessary today (eval_280, eval_323, and the eval_376 / eval_379 zero-count family).
residual_clarifications_weighed.why_the_gate_will_never_show_it: Every extraction fix converts a clarification into an answer, which the ADR bar rewards only if the answer is also right. The rate is a PRODUCT metric, not a gate metric.
residual_clarifications_weighed.TARGET_SET_BY_FOUNDER_2026_08_08: At most 15% of compute-routed questions (currently 26%), recorded as a WIRING PRECONDITION alongside the ADR bar, and tracked in every future paired run.

CALL_1_wiring.DECISION: WIRE v16 - but NOT this configuration, and not before the bar is measured on the one that ships.
approved_items_in_order: 1. Fix the eval_368 marker (own commit, R17 probe, edge_p04 and ex_10 pinned).
2. BLOCKING: drop the two-arm retriever, make single-arm the v16 arm, re-run the paired 400. The ADR bar has never been measured on the shipped configuration.

3. Output shape: state TZS 0 explicitly on applicability rejections answering "ni ngapi" (eval_378 plus the eval_376 / eval_379 family); suppress the mandatory "Hapana." lead when the model text already opened affirmatively (eval_393).
4. Clarification text for eval_291 and eval_294 - they ask "per-person or total?" when the real gap is the monthly salary or the total headcount.
CALL_1_wiring.held_until_the_bar_is_measured_on_the_sh: patterns D (+2) and F (+4). No stacking changes onto an unmeasured configuration.
CALL_1_wiring.founder_instruction_on_the_re_run: If raw lands slightly negative while the judge holds, bring the result rather than pre-arguing it - decide against a real number, not a projected one.
